run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if a binary string can be made uniform by flipping one bit
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample binary strings to verify correct one-flip detection
review_f_gold: review f_gold which counts zeros and ones to determine if one flip makes the string uniform
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use string count methods instead of a manual loop for counting
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns true when a binary string has exactly one zero or one one
